name: claude-session-usage
title: Claude Session Usage
description: Claude 5-hour and weekly usage as a menu bar ring, fed live by Claude Code (Pro or Max plan required)
author: bzvstudio

commands.name: connect-claude-code
commands.title: Connect Claude Code
commands.description: Set up Claude Code to send usage to the ring through its status line. Run this first.

commands.name: check-usage
commands.title: Check Usage
commands.description: See your Claude 5-hour and weekly usage and reset times

commands.name: usage-menu-bar
commands.title: Menu Bar Ring
commands.description: The usage ring in your menu bar. Run once to turn it on.

commands.name: toggle-usage-ring
commands.title: Toggle Usage Ring
commands.description: Show or hide the ring in the menu bar

preferences.name: ringMode
preferences.title: Ring Shows
preferences.description: What the menu bar ring displays

preferences.name: showPercentText
preferences.label: Show percentage next to the ring
preferences.description: Show e.g. 8% next to the ring

preferences.name: warnThreshold
preferences.title: Orange Threshold (%)
preferences.description: Ring turns orange from this usage. 70 means 30% or less left.

preferences.name: critThreshold
preferences.title: Red Threshold (%)
preferences.description: Ring turns red from this usage. 90 means 10% or less left.

preferences.name: claudeConfigDir
preferences.title: Claude Config Folder
preferences.description: Only needed if you run Claude Code with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. Leave empty to use ~/.claude
